subject.title: fix(secrets): keep unaffected owners live during reload failures

question: Should transient SecretRef reload failures retain credentials only when the normalized effective owner configuration is unchanged, including ignored plaintext fields in auth profiles?
rationale: The branch establishes a credential-retention boundary across reload failures. The reported edge case is mechanically fixable, but maintainers should explicitly confirm the normalized effective-profile contract as the intended safety rule.

options.title: Normalize effective auth profiles
options.body: Exclude plaintext key or token fields when their corresponding SecretRef is present before hashing the owner contract, so only meaningful owner changes force cold failure.

options.title: Keep raw-profile strictness
options.body: Treat any raw auth-profile edit, including ignored plaintext, as a change that discards stale credentials during an unavailable SecretRef reload.

recommendation.title: Normalize effective auth profiles
recommendation.body: Exclude plaintext key or token fields when their corresponding SecretRef is present before hashing the owner contract, so only meaningful owner changes force cold failure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and current work shows direct ownership of the SecretRef degradation and reload implementation.
